payload.query: My rain jacket doesn't keep water out anymore. How do I fix it?

args.text: When water stops beading on the surface of a waterproof rain jacket, you should re-waterproof it [fabric-care#5]. To do this, wash the jacket using a technical wash rather than normal detergent or fabric softener, as the latter can clog the membrane [fabric-care#5]. After washing, apply a spray-on or wash-in DWR (durable water repellent) treatment [fabric-care#5]. Finally, finish with a short low-heat tumble dry or iron on low heat (if the care label allows) to reactivate the coating [fabric-care#5].
